explication: GLM-V is a vision-language model project whose model algorithms are implemented in external Transformers code; this tree chiefly contains inference interfaces, a reward system, and specialized skills. A user-facing workflow is to submit a multimodal request through an inference interface or skill and receive a generated result. The reward subsystem evaluates model answers against ground truth through task-specific verifiers, with optional LLM judging. The README documents grounding and GUI-agent capabilities. Some skill and inference relationships are unclear from the sampled sources, so those connections are omitted.
